name: HANDMADE – Dropshipping for Etsy and WooCommerce
author: VillaTheme

sections.description:
Etsy is a vibrant marketplace known for unique, handcrafted items and vintage finds, attracting shoppers who appreciate creativity and originality. Dropshipping for Etsy is an exciting way to tap into this creative platform and earn money by offering unique products without handling inventory. By connecting the Etsy marketplace to your WooCommerce store, you can build a distinctive, profitable online shop with high-quality, artisanal goods sourced from Etsy sellers.

Dropshipping for Etsy is now easier than ever with the HANDMADE – Dropshipping for Etsy and WooCommerce plugin. This plugin enables you to import Etsy products seamlessly into WooCommerce, letting you curate your dropshipping business with the distinctive items Etsy sellers offer. With HANDMADE, you gain flexibility, ease, and control over your product importation, making it the perfect tool for WooCommerce stores looking to offer something unique in the world of dropshipping for Etsy.

Try the Demo | Documents | Extension | Facebook group

How to install and use the plugin

Important Notice:

  • Plugin works based on WooCommerce plugin and EPOW – Custom Product Options for WooCommerce plugin.

  • Your site need use SSL certificates to connect with chrome extension

  • Your permalink structure must NOT be “Plain”

  • We make no guarantees about the raw information imported from Etsy provided by our plugin and will not be held liable if it is not accurate, complete, or up to date, or if it does not otherwise satisfy your specific needs. All risks regarding to raw information and the material may not be accepted and will not be our responsibility.

  • There may be instances when information provided through the plugin contains typographical mistakes, inaccuracies, or omissions come from Etsy such as product descriptions, promotions, offers, pricing, shipping fee, availability, and delivery timeframes. Apart from official laws require, we make no commitment to correct, update, alter, or clarify such material.

  • It is released on WordPress.org and you can use plugin as free to build themes for sale.

FEATURES

With HANDMADE – Dropshipping for Etsy and WooCommerce, you have a powerful tool to easily manage and customize your products. Let’s see what you can do for your dropshipping for Etsy business:

► **Unlimited Product Imports **:

You can import an unlimited number of products from Etsy to your WooCommerce store. This means you can continually expand your product range without restrictions, giving you the ability to test different niches and find what resonates with your customers. More products mean more potential sales, leading to increased profits for your business.

► Multi-Domain Compatibility:

Connect multiple domains to HANDMADE chrome extension, allowing you to import products to all your stores at once. This feature simplifies the management of your online presence, enabling you to diversify your offerings across various markets. By reaching different audiences, you enhance your visibility and sales opportunities without the hassle of managing each site separately.

► Intuitive Import List Management:

The user-friendly interface allows you to manage your products easily in the Import List. You can review each item before it goes live, ensuring that everything meets your standards. This careful oversight means that only high-quality products are presented to your customers, which can enhance your store’s reputation and encourage repeat purchases.

► Comprehensive Pricing Control:

Control the prices of imported products with options for setting exchange rates and establishing pricing rules. You can adjust prices based on your desired profit margins, apply percentage increases, or set fixed values. This control ensures that you remain competitive in the marketplace while maximizing your earnings.

  • Set Exchange Rates: Easily establish exchange rates for different currencies to ensure accurate pricing based on current market values.

  • Pricing Rules: Apply pricing rules that allow you to: Increase sale prices by a specific percentage or fixed amount, Set regular prices at defined values, Use formulas to multiply costs for tailored pricing strategies.

  • Sale Pricing: Enable promotional pricing options to help boost sales during special events or campaigns.

► Bulk Settings:

HANDMADE – Dropshipping for Etsy and WooCommerce makes it easy to apply changes to multiple products at once, whether it’s setting categories, tags, product statuses, or visibility settings. This feature saves you time and ensures that your store is organized and easy for customers to navigate. An organized store leads to a better shopping experience, which can boost your sales.

  • Apply Changes to Multiple Products: Select and modify settings for numerous products simultaneously, saving time on repetitive tasks.

  • Bulk Set Categories and Tags: Quickly categorize and tag multiple products to streamline navigation and improve searchability in your store.

  • Product Status Management: Update the status of multiple products (e.g., publish, draft, or pending) at once, facilitating quick adjustments to your inventory.Update the status of multiple products (e.g., publish, draft, or pending) at once, facilitating quick adjustments to your inventory.

  • Visibility Settings: Adjust the visibility of products in bulk for your shop and search results. You can choose to display them, hide them, or set them to be visible in one area while hidden in another, making it easy to temporarily remove items that are out of stock or unavailable for sale.

► Flexible Product Details Editing:

HANDMADE – Dropshipping for Etsy and WooCommerce lets you tailor product descriptions, variations, and attributes to fit your brand’s voice. This level of customization not only helps improve your SEO but also enhances the overall customer experience, making your products more appealing and informative.

  • Edit Product Descriptions: You can import item specifics along with descriptions, or choose to exclude them. Then customize the text for product descriptions to align with your branding and messaging, ensuring consistency across your store.

  • Adjust Variations: Add or modify product variations such as size, color, or style to provide customers with a range of options.

  • Global vs Custom Attributes: Make the attributes of the imported items global attributes that can be reused across different products or custom attributes specific to individual items.

  • Gallery Management: Upload and edit product image, ensuring that your visual content is appealing and representative of the products.

3rd party libraries & service

  • This plugin relies on Semantic UI, Select2 to build the settings function to work properly.
    ► Semantic UI: Accordion, Transition, Tab, Dropdown, Checkbox
    ► Select2
  • This plugin includes YouTube videos for storing and providing instructions on how to use its features.
    ► Youtube guide

sections.installation:
1. Unzip the download package
  2. Upload handmade-dropshipping-for-etsy-and-woo to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
